from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    rc, cc = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    common = set(rc) & set(cc)
    line_color = min(common, key=lambda x: rc[x] + cc[x])
    rows = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v == line_color]
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v == line_color]
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in cols)]
    marked_cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in rows)]
    if not marked_rows or not marked_cols:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(marked_rows), max(marked_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    rr = [r for r in rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cc2 = [c for c in cols if c0 <= c <= c1]
    out=[]
    for ra, rb in zip(rr, rr[1:]):
        line=[]
        for ca, cb in zip(cc2, cc2[1:]):
            corners = (grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb])
            line.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out

# synthesize demo 1
D1=[[0]*27 for _ in range(27)]
for r in [5,12,19,26]:
    for c in range(27): D1[r][c]=3
for c in [2,14,26]:

for r in [5,12,19,26]:
    for c in [2,14,26]: D1[r][c]=9
for r in [19,26]: D1[r][2]=3
print('d1',transform(D1))

program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(height)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(width)
    ]
    row_counts = Counter(row_modes)
    col_counts = Counter(col_modes)
    shared = set(row_counts) & set(col_counts)
    line_color = min(shared, key=lambda color: row_counts[color] + col_counts[color])

    line_rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    line_cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]
    fill_color = Counter(
        value for row in grid for value in row if value != line_color
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    marked_rows = [
        r for r in line_rows
        if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in line_cols)
    ]
    marked_cols = [
        c for c in line_cols
        if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in line_rows)
    ]
    r0, r1 = min(marked_rows), max(marked_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    rows = [r for r in line_rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cols = [c for c in line_cols if c0 <= c <= c1]

    output = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        output_row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb])
            output_row.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 else fill_color)
        output.append(output_row)
    return output
'''
